definition.target: single-copy GROMACS DNA-self generalized force/torque minus the production CG priors evaluated on the isolated-copy geometry
definition.geometry: original retained CG geometry; each TEL22 copy is translated rigidly to a sparse periodic lattice
definition.intercopy_model_edges: forbidden geometrically: every cross-copy site distance is greater than the PaiNN cutoff
definition.production_guardrail: diagnostic self-residual: atomistic target excludes solvent/ions/other copies and the CG prior subtraction excludes cross-copy WCA by construction

prior_subtraction.definition: production CG priors evaluated on the isolated-copy geometry and subtracted from DNA-self generalized targets
prior_subtraction.wca_scope: same-copy only; cross-copy WCA omitted because copies are isolated beyond every WCA cutoff

sampling.selection: rounded linspace across the full rerun time span

split.dataset_binary_order: all training frames first, then validation frames
